deadline.value: December 15 (year not given; inferred 2026 for Fall 2027); all materials due by the deadline
deadline.quote: The application deadline is December 15th. | Applicants should carefully check to make sure that all application materials are submitted by the December 15th deadline.

gre_subject.value: Department does not accept GRE scores (no exception stated for the Physics GRE)
gre_subject.quote: ***PLEASE NOTE WE ARE NOT ACCEPTING GRE SCORES. GRE scores must not be included in the application, nor should any reference to them be made anywhere in the application.

funding.value: Not stated on the pages checked (catalogue lists TA, RA and fellowship support without a guarantee)

entry_route.value: Students without a prior master's are admitted and take more coursework (11 quarter courses vs 4 with a master's)
entry_route.quote: Students who do not have a prior Master's degree (or other equivalent degree) in Physics from UCI or another institution must take a minimum of 11 quarter courses

also.quote: The application fee is $135 for U.S. citizens and U.S. permanent residents, and $155 for all international applicants.

fee_waiver.value: International applicants are not eligible for fee waivers (no exceptions); waivers are for U.S. citizens, permanent residents and DACA/AB540 only
fee_waiver.quote: Foreign applicants are NOT eligible for graduate application fee waivers - no exceptions.

also.quote: They are open to U.S. citizens, permanent residents, and DACA/AB540 eligible only; international students are not eligible.

gre_general.value: Department does not accept GRE scores; they must not be included or mentioned
gre_general.quote: ***PLEASE NOTE WE ARE NOT ACCEPTING GRE SCORES. GRE scores must not be included in the application, nor should any reference to them be made anywhere in the application.

notes: Same application route covers the Chemical and Materials Physics (ChaMP) concentration. International PhD students must be TA-eligible; check the TA oral-English rules. Astronomy and Astrophysics is a concentration of this Ph.D. International students must be TA-eligible: TOEFL Speaking 26+ or IELTS Speaking 8+ (physics.uci.edu/apply). TOEFL, IELTS and English-waiver rules come from the university record.
